main_text.head: DEDICATORIA.
main_text.p: reno uultu à S.R.M.T. suscipéretur. Quod ut fiat, submísse oro. Denique me, & hunc meum laborē, quàm humilimè S.R.M.T. cōmendo. Omnipotēs Deus & pater Domini nostri IESV Christi, S.R.M.T. unà cum generosissima coniuge, illustrissimisq; liberis, longæuam incolumitatē, tranquillam gubernationem, omnisq; generis tam futurae q; huius uitæ bona cōcedat: ut uera fortitudine Samsonem, pietate Dauidem, sapientia Salomonem exprímat. Auertat etiam misericors Deus à S.R.M.T. totoq; eiusdem Imperio, per suos angelos, quicquid paci publicæ, ueraeq; pietati aduersatur: Amen. Datæ Basileæ, in festo Michaelis archangeli, anno reparatæ à Christo salutis M.D.LXII.

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with a few italic lines; the faint fragment at the left edge is from the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Mixed Latin spellings (e.g. "reno uultu" for "reuo uultu") are as printed; the first line is partly cropped at the start, so "reno" may be a fragment of "vultu" context; the word "reno" is uncertain [?].
